name: laxpud-vibekits
description: Laxpud's reusable skills library for code quality, project standards, and academic literature classification.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable skills for code and research work
interface.longDescription: A platform-neutral skill collection covering code comment standards, Python project configuration, and Zotero-oriented academic literature classification. The Codex adapter exposes the shared skills without adding platform-specific logic to the skill files.
defaultPrompt: Use the Zotero tag classifier skill to classify this paper.
Apply the code comment standard skill to review comments.
Use the pyproject standard skill to draft project metadata.
